evidence.quote: Amazon EMR automatically fails over to a standby master node if the primary master node fails or if critical processes, like Resource Manager or Name Node, crash.
You can launch an EMR cluster (version 5.23 or later) with three master nodes and support high availability of applications like YARN Resource Manager, HDFS Name Node, Spark, Hive, and Ganglia.

claim: In an EMR cluster (version 5.23 or later) launched with three master nodes, Amazon EMR automatically fails over to a standby master node if the primary master node fails or if critical processes, like Resource Manager or Name Node, crash.

qualifiers.scope: EMR on EC2 clusters with three master nodes

note: adjudicate-35 moved from condition (not carried by the quote): The EMR FAQ says master node; the current EMR documentation says primary node.
